cause: The ad service is running but its CPU is saturated at 99%, so requests queue and p95 latency has risen from 40 ms to 4200 ms. The frontend slows down on every page that requests ads. Nothing crashed.

evidence.claim: ad is running and healthy but at 99% CPU.
ad p95 latency rose from 40 ms to 4200 ms with no rise in error rate.
The slowest traces spend their time in the ad service's GetAds span.

alternatives_considered.why_rejected: Memory use is normal; only CPU is high.
The time is spent inside the ad service's own span, not in a call it makes.

limitations: I could not tell whether the CPU load comes from traffic volume or from something inside the service.
